topic: Day 144 — reel — The present is the only place anything is actually solvable
text:
Nothing is
solvable in
the past or
the [future].
caption:
Anxiety works on something that hasn't happened, regret on something that can't change. Neither is a place where anything can be done.

Follow for one of these a day.
